name: stage3_vol_calibration_from_c2_best

problem.metric: mean(realized_path_vol / predicted_path_vol) on production decode T=0.65/top_p=0.8/N=5
problem.cause: token CE plus mixing a mean path. Production predicted_path_vol is the mean of per-sample path stds. Averaging paths first (vol of the mean) is strictly smaller and is the wrong training target.

objective.vol_term: Huber(log E_n[std(daily close return of candidate n)], log std(realized daily close return))
objective.decode: teacher-forced Top-K=16 candidate mixture; stop-grad tokenizer; weights differentiable
objective.price_space: denormalize close with window mean/std before returns

after_smoke_18d_oos.success_vol: calibration ratio drops by at least 0.20 from 2.10 (does not need to hit 1.0-1.3 in 8 segments)

then: only if smoke_go and 18d red line hold, continue 40-60 segments under the same contract
